test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 3: Student Interacts with the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Student Logout from Course Details Page
test_cases.pre_condition: A student user 'student_newuser@example.com' is logged into the system and is currently on the 'Course Details Page' for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course, having just posted a question in the forum.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's session is terminated, and they are redirected to the 'Landing Page'. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout.
test_cases.post_condition: The student user is logged out of the system and is on the 'Landing Page'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.
